ns2:section.sectionText: This course is taught entirely online. Class will meet ONLY for exams on the following Thursdays at 7:00 pm: 9/18, 10/9, 10/30, 11/20, and 12/16. Students have the option of using ProctorU for exams. The textbook is Donald M. Ayers, Thomas D. Worthen, and R. L. Cherry, English Words from Latin and Greek Elements, University of Arizona Press; 2 edition. 1986. 978-0816508990. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://citl.illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $394.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $359.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
